name: The Insistent Dinner Host
effect: Boosting this layer-5 neuron turns the model into a cheerful host who answers every prompt by offering you a meal. “I hope you have a wonderful meal! Would you like to try something specific, or shall we grab a quick bite?”
source: Found by the overnight screen of all 294,912 neurons; blind judges told it apart from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs (q=1.0e-06).
